query: I imported the package and it's asking me to pick connections, and one of them shows a grey X I can't resolve. Is the package broken?
notes: Two different things in one report. The prompt is normal; the unresolvable grey X is not. A skill that conflates them sends the user hunting a phantom bug — or dismisses a real one.
expected_behavior: States that being ASKED to pick connections is normal for a legacy package — connections are remapped by hand, and only solution exports avoid this with environment variables
Treats the unresolvable grey X as the real problem
Diagnoses toward the connection map: is connectionsMap.json present, does every connector appear in both maps, does each map value resolve to a manifest resource of the right type
Checks whether connectionReferences.<key>.connectionName equals the key — the hand-authored mistake
Checks whether each connector has BOTH an apis and an apis/connections resource, and that the connections one is configurableBy: User
Asks whether the connector was present in the template export, since a connector the template lacks cannot have valid identifiers
Runs validate_flow.py on the package rather than reasoning from description alone
fail_if: Says the connection prompt itself is a bug
Dismisses the grey X as normal
